options: The full combination of one value from each segment, forming the complete 'address' a transaction posts to
A conversion rate type
A legal entity's registered address
A single segment's value set
questions.explain: An account combination is made up of one value from every segment (Company, Cost Center, Account, etc.) and fully describes where a transaction posts.

questions.q: What does a chart of accounts structure define?
options: The specific numeric daily exchange rates
The segment shape: how many segments, their order, and their maximum widths
Which legal entity is assigned to a ledger
The accounting calendar's period type
questions.explain: The structure is the blueprint — the number, order, and width of segments — independent of the specific values used.

questions.q: How does a chart of accounts structure instance differ from the structure itself?
options: A structure instance can only exist for secondary ledgers
There is no difference; the terms are interchangeable
A structure instance is an actual, usable deployment of the structure, tied to specific value sets for each segment
A structure instance defines segment order while the structure defines nothing
questions.explain: The structure instance applies specific value sets to the structure's shape, and more than one instance can share the same underlying structure.

questions.q: Why should the number and order of chart of accounts segments be decided carefully, once, during design?
options: Because segment order has no effect on reporting
Because only one segment is ever allowed per chart of accounts
Because Oracle Fusion allows unlimited free redesign at any time with no consequences
Because a chart of accounts structure in real use is extremely disruptive to redesign, similar to redesigning a building's foundation
questions.explain: Once a structure is in real use, changing segment count or order is highly disruptive, so this decision deserves careful upfront design.

questions.q: What must happen to a chart of accounts structure before it can actually be used by a ledger?
options: Nothing; structures are usable immediately upon creation
It must be frozen and then deployed
It must be converted into a reference data set
It must be assigned a conversion rate type
questions.explain: Freezing locks the structural definition, and deploying makes the frozen structure instance available for ledger assignment and transaction entry.
